vision: Star Trek inspired universal capabilities: everyone can obtain basic necessities, learn, contribute, explore and live within ecological limits.
qualification: A goal reference states intent, not achieved impact. Outcomes need separate evidence.

basic_needs.aim: Reduce unmet access to food, shelter, healthcare and essential services.
basic_needs.candidate_measure: Share of an affected population able to obtain a defined service within a defined time and cost.
basic_needs.machine_work: Find gaps, contradictory information and feasible logistics options.

knowledge_access.aim: Make reliable information and education accessible regardless of language or technical background.
knowledge_access.candidate_measure: Comprehension, factual accuracy and accessibility on an independently defined sample.
knowledge_access.machine_work: Translate, compare, verify and repair open educational or service information.

open_infrastructure.aim: Increase reusable, inspectable tools and interoperable public data.
open_infrastructure.candidate_measure: Number of independently reproduced integrations and resolved incompatibilities.
open_infrastructure.machine_work: Build adapters, documentation and reference tests.

scientific_capacity.aim: Speed reproducible research and practical problem solving.
scientific_capacity.candidate_measure: Independent replications and corrected errors rather than publication volume.
scientific_capacity.machine_work: Find contradictions, produce counterexamples and reproduce computations.

fair_coordination.aim: Make the effects of resource allocation choices visible and contestable.
fair_coordination.candidate_measure: Disaggregated access outcomes and documented trade-offs across affected groups.
fair_coordination.machine_work: Compare scenarios and disclose assumptions; do not impose a distribution.

ecological_limits.aim: Reduce material and energy waste while protecting ecological capacity.
ecological_limits.candidate_measure: Measured energy, materials and emissions per delivered service at comparable quality.
ecological_limits.machine_work: Find waste, simulate alternatives and check lifecycle assumptions.
